mapper.select: SELECT r.category,COUNT(*) as count FROM order_info o JOIN restaurant r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.category ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT restaurant_id AS restaurantId, COUNT(*) AS score FROM order_info o WHERE status = 2 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY restaurant_id ORDER BY score DESC
